title: The Slodderwetenschap (Sloppy Science) of Stochastic Parrots – A Plea for Science to NOT take the Route Advocated by Gebru and Bender
reasoning: The paper is a position piece centered on the ethics of AI research. It evaluates and critiques the ethical frameworks (specifically the Rawlsian perspective of justice and fairness) used in the 'Stochastic Parrots' paper and discusses the moral responsibility of scientists and the 'Ethical AI' movement.
